ModMetaData.name: Ash'karr Landmark Art
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Repaints the world-map landmark icons Ash'karr draws.
Vanilla Landmarks Expanded ships its desert landmarks as a single opaque fill at 128x128 - one colour, no outline - which reads as a coloured paper cutout on the globe. Ludeon's own Cliffs, Valley and Ruins are a translucent wash over a hard black rim, so the planet's terrain shows through and the outline carries the shape.
This mod points 48 LandmarkDefs at repainted 1024x1024 icons in that house style. Every silhouette is lifted unchanged from the shipping art, so footprints and atlas geometry are identical and nothing about worldgen or tile behaviour changes - only the picture.
The four oceanic landmarks (Bay, Peninsula, CoastalIsland, Archipelago) are left alone deliberately: they ship as pure white silhouettes so the engine can tint them the ocean's own colour, and repainting them would break that tint.
Patch-only. Load it LAST.
